sara: FYI hit an onboarding regression: js-sdk json-mode fncall helper coerces scalar->array and null->empty-array in some union schemas. sample-app crashed on first-run.

ben: can you paste the minimal repro?

sara: schema (trimmed):
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "out": {
      "oneOf": [
        { "type": "array", "items": {"type": "number"} },
        { "type": "object", "properties": {"tag":{"type":"string"}} }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
raw model resp: `{"out": ""}` (empty string) -> sdk normalized to `[""]` then downstream parse expected numbers -> crash.

lia: sounds like legacy scalar-to-array compatibility is still on. We added a strictJson flag earlier but maybe not defaulted in starter templates.

ben: two things: 1) enforce strictJsonMode=true in sample-app templates so new users get predictable behavior, 2) sdk should expose a clear coercion policy and telemetry. don’t silently fabricate containers.

sara: PR in progress: https://git.redwood/s/sdk-js/strict-normalize-default (WIP). patch changes default for new installs and adds opt-in legacyCoerce flag. also adding unit tests for union cases: null, empty-string, number, object.

ops-bot: CI queued for PR strict-normalize-default  build 10023.

ben: also audit py/go/dotnet for parity. file DEVEX-3610 to track. lia, can you lead parity checks?

lia: on it. quick note: make sure auth/retry interactions tested: we had a bug where 401+retry returned truncated body which sanitizer then coerced. Add integration that simulates a retry roundtrip and ensure sanitizer runs on final body only.

sara: added integration test to sample-app runner that simulates auth failure + retry. ensures sanitizer sees full payload. PR updated.

ben: tiny UX ask: document the coercion rules in SDK README under "json-mode behavior" and add migration snippet for older apps that relied on scalar->array conversion.

sara: will add docs + changelog. merging once CI green.

ops-bot: CI green, merged. js-sdk v2.3.1 released. starter templates updated to strictJsonMode.

lia: following up: rolling parity tasks for other sdks assigned. closing thread when DEVEX-3610 shows green on all four SDKs.

ben: great. this should reduce a bunch of onboarding confusion. :rocket:
